summary_en: Persol Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 45.1 million shares (2.0% of issued shares) for a maximum 10.0 billion yen through market purchase from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Half of acquired shares will be retained for future equity incentive plans; remainder will be canceled.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Persol Holdings' Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will purchase up to 45.1 million shares for a maximum of 10.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 12, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The acquisition represents 2.0% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, when 2,245,503,365 shares were outstanding.

The company states that treasury stock acquisition supports medium- to long-term enhancement of corporate value and continuous shareholder returns, which it identifies as a key management priority. The timing reflects the company's progress on its medium-term business plan, current financial condition, and stock price levels.

Of the acquired shares, half will be retained for use in future equity incentive compensation programs. The remaining half is scheduled to be canceled through a Board resolution under Article 178 of the Companies Act. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 32,934,445 treasury shares, including 24,180,469 shares held through the Executive Officer Compensation BIP Trust and Equity Award ESOP Trust.
